commands.test: <test runner, for example: uv run pytest>
commands.offline_args: <args that exclude the integration tier, for example: --ignore=tests/integration>
commands.integration_args: <args for the integration tier, for example: tests/integration>
commands.no_coverage_args: <args that disable the coverage threshold, for example: --no-cov>
commands.lint: <verify only, for example: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src>
commands.fix: <repair, for example: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .>
commands.import_check: <catches import cycles, for example: uv run python -c "import main">

tests.runner: <runs the given test files offline without coverage, for example: uv run pytest {files} --no-cov -q>
